text: Sorry if this is a daft one. My stepson's 10 and has a temp of 38.8 tonight. He was sick once earlier but he's kept his drinks down fine since then. He also banged his head on the edge of the table about an hour ago. He cried straight away, but he's honestly back to his normal self now, chatting and messing about. His breathing seems totally normal. His mum's away and I don't really know what's worth worrying about and what isn't. Probably overthinking it.
